# sonarqube_cloud_project_binding (Data Source)

Reads the repository binding of a SonarQube Cloud project.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "sonarqube_cloud_project_binding" "example" {
  organization = "my-organization"
  project_key  = "my-organization_my-repo"
}

output "repository" {
  value = data.sonarqube_cloud_project_binding.example.repository
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `organization` (String) Key of the organization that owns the project.
- `project_key` (String) Key of the project whose binding is read.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Identifier of the binding.
- `repository` (String) Repository that the project is bound to, as `owner/name`.
- `repository_id` (String) Identifier that the DevOps platform gives the repository.
